A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same complete 47-page paper, Exemplar-Free Continual Learning for State Space Models, including Appendices A–J. Text, content-stream and rendered-page comparisons establish identical research content; the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original continual-learning experiments in Section 5, Tables 1–3, and Appendices G–H, plus Monte Carlo results in Appendix D.5.

after.justification: v3 retains the same original benchmark results, ablations, timing measurements and Monte Carlo results.

M1.justification: The Inf-SSM regularizer, S6 adaptation, training losses, simplified distance calculation, Algorithm 1 and Inf-SSM+ variant are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use ImageNet-R, CIFAR-100 and Caltech-256 for continual-learning evaluation, with CUB-200-2011 also used in appendix analyses. No dataset, task or test scenario changes.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments. This includes the integration baselines in Table 1, EFCIL comparisons in Tables 2 and 6, UCL in Table 11, and alternative Grassmann distances in Table 8.

E3.justification: Task partitions, five- and ten-task settings, Vim-small/Vim-tiny configurations, preprocessing, metrics and training settings are unchanged throughout Section 5 and Appendices G–J.

E4.justification: The CKD state analysis, block-count ablation, simplified-distance timing comparison and Inf-SSM+ study in Appendix H are identical. Appendix D.5 also retains the same Monte Carlo validation.

E5.justification: Both specify seeds 0, 10 and 100 in Appendix J.2 and retain identical standard-deviation reporting. Monte Carlo iteration counts, correlation statistics and p-value reporting are also unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical entries, plotted results and qualitative findings match, including appendix results. For example, Table 2 reports Inf-SSM AA of 49.34 ± 3.36% on five-task ImageNet-R in both versions.

T1.justification: Mathematical definitions, assumptions, lemmas, proofs and derivations are identical, including the observability and Sylvester-equation arguments and the distance-equivalence proofs in Appendix I.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about exemplar-free geometry-aware regularization, efficient computation, compatibility with existing CL methods and empirical benefits.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the diagonal-A computational shortcut in Section 6, the approximation discussion in Appendix D.5, and the training-time and VRAM overhead described in Appendix E.

D1.justification: Algorithm descriptions, preprocessing instructions, hardware information and hyperparameters in Tables 12–19 are identical. No implementation or code/data-access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: Section 4, Appendix F and the reference list are identical. Positioning relative to existing CL and Mamba-based methods, including the geometry-specific novelty claim, is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page marginal stamp changes from arXiv:2505.18604v2, 22 Mar 2026 to arXiv:2505.18604v3, 13 May 2026. This is a limited administrative text update; prose, headings and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures, tables, captions and body layout are unchanged. Pages 2–47 render identically, and the first-page rendering difference is confined to the version/date stamp.

improvement.justification: Only the administrative arXiv version/date stamp and its associated self-link change. The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main paper and appendices, establishing no meaningful difference in overall quality.
